generate_images_ldm_pipeline: load a pretrained LDMPipeline and generate unconditional images using pipe().images[0]
generate_batch_ldm_pipeline: generate multiple images at once by calling the pipeline with batch_size set to the desired count
generate_deterministic_ldm_images: generate reproducible images by passing a torch.Generator to the pipeline call
generate_images_custom_steps: generate images with a custom number of denoising steps by setting num_inference_steps
generate_numpy_ldm_images: generate images as numpy arrays by setting output_type to np.array instead of pil
